articles.title: UK Cyber Chief Says the UK Will Face AI Cyberattacks on Critical Infrastructure by 2028
articles.summary: The U.K. will likely face AI cyberattacks on its critical infrastructure by 2028 as criminals and states, including China and Russia, increasingly use AI in their cyber activity.
